header: Where the electricity we supplied came from
lead: Two thirds renewable, a quarter gas and the remainder bought on the exchange when neither our own plants nor the contracts covered the load.
note: Shares of the 1,184 GWh supplied in 2026, from the guarantees of origin cancelled for the year and the monthly balancing statements. Rounded to whole percent, which is why the six shares add to exactly a hundred here and would not at two decimal places.
